title: SIB-200: A Simple, Inclusive, and Big Evaluation Dataset for Topic Classification in 200+ Languages and Dialects
reasoning: The paper mentions that existing datasets (e.g., Taxi-1500) can be 'biased to the religious domain' and that some of their pre-training data sources (MT560) contain 'mostly religious articles'. However, the evaluation task in this paper is topic classification using categories such as science/technology, travel, politics, sports, health, entertainment, and geography. Religion or ethics are not among the topics being classified or evaluated as part of their benchmark, nor is there any analysis of faith or ethical considerations within the evaluation.
